featured_reviews.name: Spidey thenameis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Please don’t judge me by my account name
,  I’m a real person sharing a genuine experience.

WeWork Raheja Platinum is honestly one of the best places to work. For me, it felt like a healing space, full of positivity, and the perfect environment to start work every day.

One incident really earned my respect for them:
I once forgot my small Nokia phone there. For an entire week, I didn’t even realize it was missing until I checked my bag and couldn’t find it. I searched everywhere at home but no luck. Finally, I asked the WeWork security team if they had found any phone matching my description. They asked for details about the day and place I last saw it — and to my surprise, they actually had my phone safe with them! They returned it to me without hesitation. That moment made me trust them blindly, because in many other offices, things like this just get lost, and sometimes even the CCTV doesn’t work properly. But here, the staff were so honest and professional.

Another time, I was feeling very sleepy on the 9th floor and dozed off on a chair in a weird position. The staff came quietly just to check if I was okay — without disturbing me. That showed how much they care for people’s well-being, not just their work.

I left WeWork some time back, but I know I’ll return someday — even if it’s just with a day pass. And I can’t forget to mention the beautiful, warm community team 🥹😍 — they truly made the place feel like home.

💙 Love you all guys 🫂
